regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing eligible universe (7 of 16 themes) led nominally by Oil & Gas Producers, but the leader's own momentum score is negative (-0.117 on r10), durability is weak (0.41), breadth is zero, and hurst is mean-revert — a hollow leadership crown. Banks and Consumer show the most durable eligible trend structure. Track record hit rate is modest (55.8%) with direction accuracy near coin-flip (31.3%), so calibration defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watching Utilities & Renewables (XUT.TO) as a possible stealth rotation target: its trend hurst tag is strong, durability is highest in the eligible universe (0.81), breadth is 0.917, and crowding is negative (-0.27, uncrowded). Confirm only if XUT.TO's 20-day relative strength versus the S&P/TSX turns positive and holds for 5 consecutive sessions — that would retire the watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the highest-scoring eligible theme with genuinely durable trend characteristics: durability 0.70, breadth 0.714, no crowding, and the absolute-trend gate is validated as the one risk-control edge. While momentum rank is not a return forecast, the durability and breadth legs suggest this is the most structurally sound place to express the eligible, trend-gated universe on the TSX.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mixed', and Canadian banks are heavily exposed to domestic mortgage and credit cycles which could turn faster than the trend durability suggests; the momentum score itself is not a return edge.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO (Big Banks proxy) trades below its 20-day VWAP for 8 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The nominal leader carries the weakest internal structure of any top-ranked theme: r10 momentum is negative (-0.117), durability is 0.41, breadth is 0.0 (no internal confirmation), and hurst is mean-revert. It is ranked first by the attention/focus lens but none of the coincident quality legs support participation. An 'avoid' lean here means do not express the leadership; it does not constitute a short or fade.
theses.dissent: Energy can gap sharply on geopolitical headlines (dominant macro narrative includes geopolitics at n=4), and mean-revert tags can flip quickly with a supply shock.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO (Oil & Gas proxy) closes above its 50-day high with breadth (advancers/decliners among XEG members) exceeding 0.6 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer has the strongest momentum durability (0.80) and perfect breadth (1.0) with a trend hurst tag, but it is flagged crowded (z=1.02, crowded=true). This is a size-down caution on a structurally sound trend, not a fade. Leaning underweight relative to the eligible trend-gated universe reflects the crowding texture tempering the otherwise strong durability.
theses.dissent: Staples and retail often hold up in mean-revert or defensive rotations, and crowding alone has no basket-level forward edge — capping could forfeit a legitimate durable trend.

falsifier.text: XST.TO (Consumer Staples proxy) underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by 3% cumulatively while maintaining breadth above 0.8 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
